Core Modules

Employee Transport Software (ETS) & Unified Sourcing

Algorithmic routing, automated shift allocation, and real-time vehicle telemetry.

Automated Shift Rostering & Routing

Our dispatch engine ingests shift schedules directly from Darwinbox, Workday, or spreadsheets, automatically generating optimized cluster routes that group employees living along the same IT corridor.

  • Dynamic pickup sequencing minimizing employee in-cab travel time
  • OTP-based boarding with geofenced arrival alerts
  • Live vehicle speed, path tracking, and instant panic SOS alerts

Travel + Transport in One Platform

Both daily employee shifts and ad-hoc executive spot cabs (airport transfers, client delegations, inter-campus visits) run on one policy engine, one GST invoice, and a single approval chain.

  • Unified travel desk console for transport managers
  • Automated departmental cost center tagging
  • Guaranteed 15-minute search cutoff with 1-hour bank refund SLA
